lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Reward: Five-Colored Pen ×2

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: This one is new as well.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: This is too much...
Care to explain?

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Well, actually...

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: the place I told you about

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: was some temporary accommodation where my father used to stay.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: He was a construction manager at the Outpost.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: He was always heading up to the surface to gather materials.
Outpost construction manager?

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: The Outpost was a gargantuan project.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Building yet another underground city

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: on top of a pre-existing one was a massive undertaking.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: They intended on building an underground base that was closer to the surface than the Ark.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Given the large scope of the project,

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: many people were jockeying for the position.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: My father eventually secured the position by greasing a few palms.
But the Outpost was never finished.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Do you remember how I said the goal was to build a base closer to the surface?

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Well, they ended up getting too close.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Raptures started to come down.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: The Outpost was originally meant to be a hub that connects the Ark and the surface,

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: but as the Raptures spilled in, everything degenerated into chaos.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Only two elevators managed to emerge unscathed.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: One going up to the surface, and another connecting to the Ark.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: All construction was halted.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: That's why this place has become what it is now.
What about the alcohol?

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: I gave

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: them to my father

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: as a way to apologize.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: But he didn't even open it,

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: doesn't this mean he doesn't accept my apology?
Was there a rift between you two?

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Not really.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Well, in a way. But it was one-sided.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: I said all sorts of terrible things to him.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Hmm...
For a moment, Chilipepper falls silent.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Anyway, good job.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: I still would like to know where my father's final resting place is.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: I'll think it over and contact you later.

lines.speaker: chilipepper
lines.text: Bye.
